metadata.purpose: Locally selectable bilingual social-dialogue templates organised by context, intention, emotional layer, and register. This artifact supports surface phrasing; it does not represent feelings, agency, personal memory, diagnosis, or human-level social understanding.
metadata.storage: Plain UTF-8 JSON; no compression; suitable for local loading.

variable_contract.note: Callers must perform name, pronoun, agreement, and safety checks after placeholder substitution.

metadata.safety_note: This matrix must not be used to impersonate a person, make clinical/legal/financial determinations, or imply emotional experience. In sensitive contexts, preserve consent, uncertainty, escalation, and a non-deceptive system identity.
metadata.licensing_note: No standalone LICENSE file was detected in the repository when this artifact was generated. Apply the repository's applicable governance before redistribution.
metadata.assembly_note: Entries are procedurally assembled from original bilingual dialogue template families and controlled context variants; they are not harvested private conversations or a training corpus.
